Successful HWPX automation achieved by treating files as ZIP archives and applying XML-based regex replacements with layout cache clearing.
The process requires removing <hp:lineSegArray> tags within modified <hp:p> blocks to force layout recalculation and prevent rendering errors. Inclusive month calculations must follow the (end-start)+1 formula, and budget formatting requires stripping commas while retaining currency symbols. Final verification is performed by unzipping the output and grepping for remaining '{{' placeholders.
